recipient: Pyra c06/c07 (`eflame`) wearing the G&W reskin, on the built grafted skeleton

provenance.donor: Little Mac, live-extracted from the console 2026-09-30 because `dumps/arc/fighter/littlemac` is empty on disk (0 of its 4290 indexed files)
provenance.rule: every byte below is the donor's own; nothing is authored, approximated or stand-in (AGENTS.md rule 17)

acmd_sources.registered: 15 handlers: game/effect/sound/expression_attacks4, ..._attacks4charge, and all four of ..._attacks4hi and ..._attacks4lw, each at Priority::High over the generated G&W handlers

motion_entries_taken.note: each donor entry is copied whole - kind, game_script, flags, blend, animation name, cancel frame - so the donor's own cancel window travels with the clip. Measured readings, all tier B:

retarget.method: same as build_chrom_jab.py and build_robot_dtilt.py: keep only transform nodes that exist on the BUILT recipient skeleton, take G&W's idle mesh-visibility group, drop the donor's own Material group
retarget.why_built_skeleton: Pyra's bones are grafted onto G&W's; filtering against the built skeleton is what keeps the finger and elbow helpers the graft contributed
retarget.note: the 4 dropped bones are helpers off the arm, not part of Bust->ClavicleC->ClavicleR->ShoulderR->ArmR->HandR->HaveR, and every hitbox in all four kinds is parented to `armr`, which is kept

sounds.method: tools/merge_donor_sound.py merges the donor banks into Pyra's c06/c07 banks by whole-bank transplant; lookup is crc32(name.lower()), measured

effects.note: the line is the neutral punch, the arc is used by both angled variants

angled_variants.status: SHIPPED as of 0.20.16, on the reasoning below. Whether the engine routes to them on this recipient is the open question and is what the console run tests.
angled_variants.superseded_verdict: An earlier revision of this file recorded these as NOT SHIPPED, blocked behind a native hook, on the grounds that no name or hash for them exists anywhere in the shipped binaries. That inference was wrong.
why_the_inference_was_wrong: Measured (tier B): 'attack_s4_hi', 'attack_s4_lw', 'SMASH_S', 'SMASH_HI' and 'SMASH_LW' have 0 ASCII hits and 0 u64 hash40 hits in dumps/exefs/13.0.4/main.bin (86,672,752 B). So the engine does not name them there. That part was right.

Also measured (tier B): 65 of the 72 fighters with a c00 motion list on disk DO carry attack_s4_hi and attack_s4_lw, with their own c03attacks4hi/c03attacks4lw clips and the same game_script split (game_attacks4 / game_attacks4hi / game_attacks4lw / game_attacks4charge). The 7 that lack the pair are chrom diddy eflame elight gamewatch miiswordsman younglink.

A convention 65 shipped fighters follow and 7 do not is missing content, not a missing engine route. If the engine could not reach the angled kinds, those 65 entries would be dead weight in their own files - and Little Mac's angled forward smash is a real, working, played move in the base game, which is direct counter-evidence to 'unreachable'.

The absence of FIGHTER_STATUS_KIND_ATTACK_S4_HI is likewise not evidence: the angled variants need no separate status. The motion list entry carries its own `game_script` field, and a motion with no script registered for it is exactly a move that animates and hits nothing - which is why the plugin registers all four handler sets here rather than relying on the entry alone.
angled_variants.no_native_hook_needed: all three parts of the mechanism are inside the mod: the motion entries come from the pinned donor list, the clips from the retarget, and the scripts from the plugin. Nothing hooks the game's input-to-status decision (AGENTS.md rule 17 is not engaged).
angled_variants.open_question: Does the engine ask for the angled motion kinds on eflame at all? Only a console run answers this. The build is staged so that a 'no' costs nothing - an unrouted entry is inert - and a 'yes' gives Little Mac's real angled f-smash.
